attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican Party honors the extraordinary sacrifices of men and women in U.S. territories who serve in the U.S. Armed Forces.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party welcomes greater participation of residents of U.S. territories in all aspects of the political process.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party affirms the right of residents of U.S. territories to seek the full extension of the Constitution, with all its rights and responsibilities.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. territories face serious economic challenges as they struggle to retain existing industries and develop new ones.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Development of local energy options is crucial for U.S. territories to reduce their dependence on imported fuel and promote economic stability.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Pacific territories should have flexibility to determine the minimum wage.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A stronger private sector in U.S. territories can raise wages, reduce dependence on public sector employment, and lead toward local self-sufficiency.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"All unreasonable economic impediments, including unreasonable U.S. customs practices, must be removed from U.S. territories.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
